releaseNotes: Initial Glance preview release.
Added the Torrent module, powered by MonoTorrent, for focused downloads inside Glance.
Open .torrent files and magnet links directly with Glance, or add them through drag and drop, paste, and the contextual module picker.
Review torrent metadata before downloading, including name, total size, file count, individual files, trackers, destination, and validation errors.
Choose which files to download and see the selected size before confirmation.
Track live progress, download and upload speed, peer count, metadata retrieval, and download state.
Pause or resume all downloads from the island and safely remove entries with separate options for keeping or deleting downloaded data.
Restore active downloads, metadata, and fast-resume state after restarting Glance, with safe asynchronous shutdown.
Handle repeated torrent additions using familiar numbered folder names instead of blocking duplicate downloads.
Configure destination, download and upload limits, connection limits, seeding behaviour, ratio and time limits, and optional completion attention.
Added dedicated compact and expanded Torrent experiences, desktop confirmation and removal overlays, localized UI, and packaged MonoTorrent runtime dependencies.
Added Network Speed with live download and upload readings and performance graphs.
Added Network details for the current connection type, adapter, IPv4 address, link speed, and direct access to Windows network settings.
Added camera and microphone usage monitoring, microphone mute control, and camera privacy settings access.
Greatly reduced startup blocking by loading modules responsively while keeping the first island module stable as the rest arrive.
Restored file drag-and-drop and contextual routing, and improved island activation, dismissal, and topmost behaviour.
Restored the previously selected module after returning from Infinity.
Eliminated App Mixer process-query exception storms caused by inaccessible or short-lived audio processes.
Improved module settings with Fluent cards, consistent control sizing, immediate saving, correctly placed validation messages, and aligned breadcrumb chevrons.
Refined Torrent compact and expanded layouts, metadata and file selection, removal actions, duplicate handling, and settings.
Added the Voice Notes three-line empty state and updated localized no-recording messages.
Expanded tests for Torrent validation, restoration, seeding policy, runtime limits, duplicate naming, completion attention, disposal, and shell intent compatibility.
Rewrote the project documentation with a concise overview, module catalogue, build instructions, and module development and packaging guidance.
Glance now requires Windows 11 build 22000 or later across project targets, package manifests, and direct installer startup.
Fixed a Voice Notes localization resource crash that could occur while modules were loaded or browsed in Settings.
Fixed a shutdown crash by disposing module-owned WinUI windows and controls on the application UI thread, with idempotent Color Picker teardown.
Stabilized startup module presentation by loading enabled modules in the saved order, keeping the first configured module selected while the rest load.
Completed module installation and removal localization across every supported language.
Resolved repository-enforced syntax diagnostics and restored a warning-free full solution build.
Added System Indicators, a transient module for volume and mute, display brightness, Caps Lock, Num Lock, Scroll Lock, and airplane mode.
System indicators now appear temporarily without entering module paging or ordering, preserve the current expanded state, block background scrolling, and dismiss automatically.
Added a synchronized Fluent push transition between the active module and temporary system indicators.
Added compact and expanded loading shimmer placeholders that keep module content and the footer hidden until every startup module is ready, then cross-fade into the settled first module.
Restored live GPU usage to System Monitor in compact and expanded views and removed redundant network throughput now covered by Network Speed.
Refined Network Speed and System Monitor spacing and metric layouts for closer alignment with the rest of Glance.
Rebalanced module accent colours across Audio Switcher, Drop Shelf, Presence, Quick Convert, Screen Lens, System Monitor, Torrent, World Clock, and System Indicators.
Added automatic background update checking and downloading, with localized update-ready notifications and safe restart-to-apply behaviour for direct Glance installations.
Extended the module contract, preference handling, documentation, packaging, and tests for transient components and System Indicators.
Added taskbar mode, allowing Glance to sit beside the system tray and expand on hover with adaptive support for standard and small taskbars.
Added a Spotify remote player with account connection, playback controls, device switching, seeking, album artwork, and dynamic artwork colours.
Added guided on-device speech model setup for Voice Assistant with reusable background downloads, progress, cancellation, and recovery.
Added view-aware module lifecycle support so modules can pause background work while they are out of view.
Improved taskbar placement, adaptive module layouts, drag and hover behaviour, Spotify playback reliability, and island transitions.
Added Speech to Text for live on-device transcription with microphone switching, play and pause controls, and recent transcription lines.
Added modular transcription providers with downloadable Whisper and NVIDIA Nemotron model choices.
Shared model discovery, selection, download state, and audio capture across Voice Assistant and Speech to Text.
Added safe headless .glance provider packaging so transcription engines and their private dependencies stay isolated from Glance.
Refined source selectors, accent playback controls, and expanded layouts across Glance modules.
